message.reasoning_content:
We need count numbers 1..1000 divisible by 3 or 5, exclude those divisible by 7. Use inclusion-exclusion.

Count A = multiples of 3: floor(1000/3)=333
B = multiples of 5: floor(1000/5)=200
A∩B = multiples of 15: floor(1000/15)=66

So total divisible by 3 or 5 = 333+200-66=467.

Now need to subtract those that are also divisible by 7 (i.e., divisible by 7 and (3 or 5)). Count C = numbers divisible by 7 and (3 or5). Compute multiples of lcm(7,3)=21: floor(1000/21)=47
Multiples of lcm(7,5)=35: floor(1000/35)=28
But those counted twice are multiples of lcm(7,3,5)=lcm(21,5)=105: floor(1000/105)=9

So numbers divisible by 7 and (3 or5) = 47+28-9=66.

Thus desired count = 467 - 66 = 401.

Answer integer only: 401.
